What are the signs of an upper motor neurone lesion?
Increased tone, brisk reflexes, clonus, an extensor plantar response and little wasting.

Decreased tone, reduced or absent reflexes, wasting and fasciculation.

What are the head signs of rickets?
Craniotabes, frontal and parietal bossing, a large late-closing fontanelle and delayed teeth.

What are the limb signs of rickets?
Wide wrists and ankles, and bow legs or knock knees.
